Build a complete AI Data Engineering project from scratch — Zomato/food delivery dataset → AWS S3 → Snowflake → dbt → Apache Airflow → AI (OpenAI).
In this end-to-end data engineering project, you'll learn how to:
Load 10M+ orders from S3 into Snowflake
Build Bronze/Silver/Gold medallion layers with dbt & data quality tests
Orchestrate the entire pipeline with Airflow
Add an AI layer: LLM review enrichment, RAG (chat with your reviews) & text-to-SQL (chat with your warehouse) using OpenAI
